headline: Why does being alone feel heavier now than it used to?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see the picture, yet your hand found the card with the fullest table.
A cup, a coin, a blade and a wand fill the table before him.
You asked why being alone feels heavier now. What catches me is the full table beside one figure.
The solitude is not new, but the weight of it has changed.
Something sits between what is available and company. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's behind this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The card was hidden, but your hand went to the calmest figure here.
He hangs by one ankle. Look at his face — it is calm.
You asked why solitude carries more weight than it did. This card makes me stay with the calm inside the stillness.
Still, the same condition now feels harder to carry.
Whatever has hold of the solitude makes its weight harder to carry. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what's holding this…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing on the backs told you, but you chose the one travelling with one small bundle.
The bundle on his stick is small, and the sky around him is wide.
You asked why being alone feels heavier now. The small bundle in all that space holds my eye.
But the open space has become heavier than it used to feel.
At the point where open space should become movement, something appears. I don't think it started with you.
Now let's look at what's behind it…
